sloka: तस्मिन् जीवति वीरे तु हतमप्यहतं बलम्।हनुमत्युज्झितप्राणे जीवन्तो ऽपि वयं हताः ।। ६.७४.२२ ।।
transliteration: tasmin jīvati vīre tu hatamapyahataṁ balam।hanumatyujjhitaprāṇe jīvanto 'pi vayaṁ hatāḥ ।। 6.74.22 ।।

translations.english: If this hero Hanuman is alive, even if the army is destroyed and if we are alive, it is like dead only.
